Chapter 903: Chapter 7: The Sixth Physical Body Divine Ability_2

Chapter 903: Chapter 7: The Sixth Physical Body Divine Ability_2

“I heard that the Hall Master of Flying Immortal Hall has requested Master Yun Zhenzi to refine Nine Revolutions Golden Pills,” the elder with white hair said.

He had extensive connections and knew many secret pieces of intelligence.

“I’m aware of this.”

The Azure Dragon Sect Master nodded.

After his negotiations with Yun Zhenzi collapsed, the Hall Master of Flying Immortal Hall even specifically inquired about the conditions Yun Zhenzi had proposed.

“It seems that the Hall Master of Flying Immortal Hall holds Master Yun Zhenzi in high regard,” the white-haired elder said with a smile.

With the status of the Hall Master of Flying Immortal Hall, he could completely invite a top-tier Alchemy Master to refine the Nine Revolutions Golden Pills.

But in the end, he chose Yun Zhenzi? The only explanation is that he sees great promise in him.

How important is the Nine Revolutions Golden Pill? One would certainly have a trusted Alchemy Master refine it; otherwise, if the refining fails, the loss of all the main ingredients and auxiliary herbs would be enormous.

“Refining the Nine Revolutions Golden Pill, approval alone isn’t enough; it still requires the true strength of the Alchemy Master,” the Azure Dragon Sect Master said indifferently.

He had just failed in negotiations with Yun Zhenzi when the Hall Master of Flying Immortal Hall went to talk to Yun Zhenzi immediately after, which was somewhat embarrassing for the Azure Dragon Sect Master.

“That’s true.”

“To be successfully formed, the Nine Revolutions Golden Pill must endure nine divine tribulations.”

The white-haired elder nodded, “From this aspect, we can see the level of accomplishment of an Alchemy Master. The most top-tier Alchemy Masters, when refining a Nine Revolutions Golden Pill, will perfectly merge the many medicinal qualities within it, easily transcending the nine divine tribulations. Slightly lesser Alchemy Masters…”

Before the white-haired elder could finish,

Above the vault of heaven, within the dark tribulation clouds, divine tribulations began descending.

Boom boom boom.

Streaks of white, cyan, and purple lightning surged into the Grade-A cave dwelling where Lin Yuan was located.

In less than an instant,

The nine divine tribulations ended one after another, and the dark tribulation clouds above the heavens began to dissipate.

Rich pill fragrances faintly spread to nearly half of Cangwu Immortal City.

“Hmm?”

“Was it a successful refining?”

The white-haired elder was taken aback; nine rounds of the divine tribulation had descended perfectly, and the scent of pills emanating outwards meant that the refining of Nine Revolutions Golden Pills had been successful.

“This batch of Nine Revolutions Golden Pills refined by Master Yun Zhenzi is of very high quality, a level that many top-tier Alchemy Masters may not be able to achieve,” the white-haired elder said as he gently inhaled the pill fragrance.

Although he was not an Alchemy Master himself, he was still quite familiar with many Immortal Pills. The fleeting fragrance emitted by the Nine Revolutions Immortal Pills upon their formation indicated the quality of the refining.

“Very high quality?”

The Azure Dragon Sect Master beside him fell silent.

Despite his reluctance to believe it, he had come to a similar conclusion.

“Azure Dragon Sect Master, you should have agreed to Master Yun Zhenzi’s conditions. A mere tens of millions of top-grade Immortal Crystals are nothing; if the twenty Nine Revolutions Golden Pills that are refined are all of this quality, it will definitely be a huge profit,” the white-haired elder said in a low voice.

Even among Nine Revolutions Golden Pills, they are of different grades according to quality.

The highest-quality Nine Revolutions Golden Pills can instantly heal all injuries of a Golden Immortal and also have a great effect on Jade Immortals.

For Alchemy Masters, occasionally refining one or two Nine Revolutions Golden Pills might involve an element of luck and state of mind.

But refining a batch of extremely high-quality Nine Revolutions Golden Pills is wholly a testament to one’s own strength.

From this batch of Nine Revolutions Golden Pills refined by Yun Zhenzi, it is apparent that Yun Zhenzi’s alchemical accomplishments far exceed those of ordinary Alchemy Masters.

“Weren’t you saying that Yun Zhenzi was just an ordinary Alchemy Master?” The Azure Dragon Sect Master frowned, looking at the white-haired elder.

If the white-haired elder had made it clear that Yun Zhenzi was also a top-tier Alchemy Master, he might have agreed to Yun Zhenzi’s terms.

“I really didn’t know.” The white-haired elder felt a bit helpless. Who could have anticipated that Yun Zhenzi, who had disappeared for nearly ten million years, would have made such leaps and bounds in his alchemical skills?

“And now?” The white-haired elder looked at the Azure Dragon Sect Master tentatively.

“Contact Master Yun Zhenzi for me again, tell him I’ve agreed to all his terms,” the Azure Dragon Sect Master said immediately.

Although he hadn’t reached a cooperation with Yun Zhenzi previously, the Azure Dragon Sect Master felt that Yun Zhenzi would not be averse to top-grade Immortal Crystals.

The reward for refining twenty Nine Revolutions Golden Pills is ten million top-grade Immortal Crystals, which even a top-tier Alchemy Master would find hard to refuse.

“Okay, I’ll try,”

The white-haired elder nodded.

…

Grade-A Cave Dwelling.

Lin Yuan looked at the thirteen round, golden Immortal Pills in front of him.

The rich life force circulated within each Immortal Pill.

“Is this the Nine Revolutions Immortal Pill?” Lin Yuan was also refining such a high-level pill for the first time, observing it carefully for a while.

“With one furnace able to refine thirteen Nine Revolutions Golden Pills, the main ingredients and auxiliary herbs were used to their full potential,” Lin Yuan thought.

Normally, even the topmost Alchemy Masters couldn’t possibly utilize every bit of medicinal power; a furnace of Nine Revolutions Golden Pills might at most form five or six pills.

The rest of the medicinal properties would be wasted.

But Lin Yuan was different, even if it was just a trivial incarnation, his spiritual will was such that he could perfectly use every bit of the medicinal power for Solidifying Pills.

That’s why there were thirteen Nine Revolutions Golden Pills from one furnace.

“Based on my current rate of pill formation, the batch of main ingredients and auxiliary herbs given to me by the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall could fully be refined into more than a hundred Nine Revolutions Golden Pills.”

A smile emerged on Lin Yuan’s face.

The agreement between the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall and him was to refine fifty Nine Revolutions Golden Pills with that batch of main ingredients and auxiliary herbs.

Lin Yuan could refine over a hundred Nine Revolutions Golden Pills. After giving the fifty agreed upon to the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall, he could naturally keep the rest for himself.

And this, for Lin Yuan, was a huge amount of cultivation resources. With the rarity of Nine Revolutions Golden Pills, Lin Yuan could completely use barter to exchange for resources like ‘Immortal Origin’ that weren’t circulated in the market.

“Alchemy, is truly a lucrative affair…” Lin Yuan felt quite moved in his heart.

This time, he only spent a month on alchemy, and it was just a month for an incarnation, but he harvested more than a dozen top-quality Nine Revolutions Golden Pills which could sell for tens of millions or even hundreds of millions of top-grade Immortal Crystals on the market.

Such an efficiency in amassing wealth… even plundering couldn’t compare.

Not to mention the many risks and hidden dangers that come with plundering.

…

“Master.”

After completing a furnace of Nine Revolutions Golden Pills, Lin Yuan received a request to meet from Yun Zhenzi.

“What is it?” Lin Yuan appeared on the throne, looking down at Yun Zhenzi below.

“That Azure Dragon Sect Master wants to meet with Master again, saying he agrees to the conditions and is willing to offer ten million Immortal Crystals just for Master to help him with the alchemy.”

Yun Zhenzi immediately reported.

“All conditions are agreed upon?”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, “The conditions have changed now.”

“If the Nine Dragons Commerce Association wants me to personally refine twenty Nine Revolutions Golden Pills, they need to pay out fifty million top-grade Immortal Crystals as remuneration,” Lin Yuan said.

Just now, after Lin Yuan successfully refined the Nine Revolutions Golden Pills, at least dozens of powers from the Thirty-Three Immortal Domains requested his help in refining Nine Revolutions Golden Pills.

Lin Yuan no longer cared about the mere ten million top-grade Immortal Crystals from the Azure Dragon Sect Master.

“Yes.”

Yun Zhenzi nodded, his figure disappeared on the spot to reply to the Azure Dragon Sect Master.

…

Cave Cultivation Area.

Lin Yuan was mainly observing the irregular crack above the vault of heaven, with a small part of his mind and energy devoted to contemplating the palm-sized Divine Skill imprint deep within his body, made up of endless mysterious runes.

This Divine Skill imprint represented Lin Yuan’s sixth Physical Body Divine Ability. During this sojourn in the Immortal Realm, re-walking the path of Martial Tao with the foundation of this flesh and blood lineage, he unearthed this Martial Divine Ability.

Compared to the previous five Physical Body Divine Abilities, the sixth Divine Ability that Lin Yuan awoke was more extreme.

“Finally… I’ve completely penetrated the insights of this Divine Skill imprint.”

Inside Lin Yuan, that deep and complicated Divine Skill imprint seemed to hold no more secrets, its many mysteries fully revealed in Lin Yuan’s eyes.

To bring a Physical Body Divine Ability back to the Main Universe, one must fully comprehend the corresponding Divine Skill imprint.

And just now, Lin Yuan had completely penetrated the insights of this Divine Skill imprint.

Among the many Physical Body Divine Abilities that Lin Yuan controlled, the longest contemplation time was spent on this particular Divine Ability, taking a full five hundred years.

“This Divine Ability…”

Lin Yuan extended his right hand, a breath that shook the soul coiled around his fingertips.
